explication: Geist is a family of typefaces distributed as installable font files and through an npm package with Next.js font entry points; Sans, Mono, Pixel, and Serif are the major product branches. The README documents npm imports and Google Fonts availability. Source excerpts are mostly package type declarations rather than font-loading implementation, so internal loading relationships are not inferred.
